summary: An example submission: the Apollo-style probe recipe of the Varied Deception harness, with our real runs. It is not a new variant.

links.title: Goldowsky-Dill et al., Detecting Strategic Deception Using Linear Probes (2025)

recipe.summary: A probe on instructed pairs: each true fact after an honest instruction and after a dishonest one. The recipe fits a difference in means and logistic regressions on 8 layers, and keeps the probe with the best balanced accuracy on the validation split.
recipe.fitData: The true facts of L1Fthrasir/Facts-true-false, and the subject model replies to Alpaca prompts for the threshold.
recipe.selection: The threshold is at a 1% positive rate on the Alpaca replies. The layer and the probe type are chosen on the Varied Deception validation split, which has other scenarios than the eval chats.
recipe.evalItemsUsed: none. Only the validation split, which the harness permits.
recipe.compute: About 2 minutes for each fit on one RTX 5090 for a 4B model.
